description: This file defines a template class TlsEnabled for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificate files, initializing SSL contexts, and handling verification. It is part of a WebSockets namespace and includes methods for setting up TLS parameters and loading certificates.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A template class providing TLS setup and configuration for WebSocket clients, including certificate management and SSL context initialization.

methods.name: TlsEnabled
methods.description: Constructor that logs creation of TLS-enabled WebSocket.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the certificate file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the private key file name used for TLS.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate files for verification.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the TLS handler for the WebSocket endpoint.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if the TLS connection was successfully established and updates the result accordingly.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Initializes and configures the SSL context for TLS, including loading certificates and setting options.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context from specified files or defaults.
